sections.heading: 1. HTML Document Skeleton & Boilerplate
sections.content: Har HTML5 page <!DOCTYPE html> se start hota hai jo browser ko standard mode batata hai. <html> tag poore document ko enclose karta hai, <head> mein metadata aur title hota hai, aur <body> mein web page ka visible content hota hai.

sections.heading: 3. Links & Images ( and Tags)
sections.content: (anchor tag) href attribute ke saath hyperlinks banata hai. External links ko new tab mein open karne ke liye target='_blank' lagate hain. tag self-closing hota hai jisme src aur alt attributes sabse important hote hain.

definitions_and_terms.definition: Declaration that informs the browser this is an HTML5 document.
Hypertext Reference: Anchor tag ka attribute jo target URL define karta hai.
Alternative text jo image load na hone par ya screen readers ke liye display hota hai.

common_pitfalls: Multiple <h1> tags ek single page par use karna jo SEO ranking distort karta hai.
tag mein alt attribute omit karna jisse accessibility score down hota hai.
File paths mein spelling mistake ya wrong relative folder reference karna.
revision_checklist: Kya <!DOCTYPE html> document ke start mein present hai?
Kya page par exactly ek <h1> tag hai?
Kya external links par target='_blank' use kiya gaya hai?
Kya har tag mein meaningful alt text provided hai?
